title: Top K Frequent Elements
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k values that occur most often in nums. You may return the selected values in any order.
constraints: 1 <= k <= number of distinct values in nums
The inputs guarantee a unique set of k most frequent values.

examples.explanation: 1 occurs three times and 2 occurs twice.

python.display_signature: def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]
